body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest a burst of elemental power in a 1-unit burst within 5 units. On a success against each creature, deal 1 Fire damage.

surges.html: Choose one creature damaged by this Action; apply Burning.
Create a second 1-unit burst within 2 units of the first. A creature can be affected by only one burst.

rider.title: ELEMENTAL — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Elemental.
